### Object detection using DOTA dataset and training using YOLOV8 (2025) 
  
-   Detect objects such as airplanes in aerial images using the **DOTA dataset** and the **YOLOv8s**      model.

-   A subset of the DOTA dataset was selected and converted from oriented bounding box (OBB) format to     COCO format for compatibility with YOLOv8.

-   The YOLOv8 model was trained on the prepared dataset using preprocessing, data augmentation, and      validation steps to improve detection performance.

-   The trained model accurately detects objects in test images and the outputs are visualized through     an interactive Python-based interface.

### Kerala Landslide & Rainfall Trends Visualization (2023-24)

-   Developed an **interactive map** of Kerala using Python’s **Folium**.
-   Integrated **GeoJSON** for district boundaries.
-   Used **Matplotlib** to visualize rainfall trends and landslide severity.

### ️ Land Use Change Detection – Norcia, Italy (2023-24)

-   Analyzed **pre- and post-earthquake land patterns** (2016 Italy earthquake).
-   Used **remote sensing & GIS techniques** for land-use classification.

### Human-Elephant Conflict & Forest Fire Risk Assessment (2022)

-   Applied **Frequency Ratio & Weighted Overlay GIS modeling**.
-   Studied **vulnerability patterns** in **Muthanga Wildlife Range, Kerala**.
